texts: Hi everyone Let's start the Arbor Bikes app review Priya from Design is joining us today
Hi I'm Priya I'd like to walk through the new first screen
Hi Leo here I look after the backend
Some background first Over the last quarter forty-one percent of support tickets were about buying or renewing ride passes
That matches what we see in testing The pass button is hidden two levels deep in the menu
So the question is whether ride passes should move to the first screen
I'd say yes Show the active pass at the top with a renew button right there
I agree One concern though Unlocking a bike currently takes two point three seconds Seconds at the median and people tap twice when it's slow
Can you measure that properly before we commit to a design
Sure I'll measure the unlock API latency and share it I can't promise a date yet I need to check the sprint first
Fine we'll set the deadline once you've checked
I'll have the mockups ready by next Thursday
Great So we agree Passes move to the first screen and the referral program stays out of this release
Agreed One thing we haven't settled is whether to keep the old map view for older phones
Let's leave that open and revisit it next week Thanks everyone
